post.description:
Chat endpoint backed by OpenRouter.

Routing strategy
----------------
1. If `request.model` is provided, that model (or comma-separated
   fallback chain) is used directly.
2. Otherwise DEFAULT_MODELS is used — OpenRouter tries each model in
   order, skipping any that are down or rate-limited.

Docs:
  https://openrouter.ai/docs/quickstart
  https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/routing/model-fallbacks
  https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/routing/provider-selection
